 4                THE SECRETARY:   Legislative 

 5   Resolution Number 463, by Senator Marchione, 

 6   memorializing Governor Andrew M. Cuomo to 

 7   proclaim March 21, 2015, Down Syndrome Awareness 

 8   Day in the State of New York, in conjunction with 

 9   the observance of World Down Syndrome Day.  

10                "WHEREAS, It is the custom of this 

11   Legislative Body to recognize official days that 

12   are set aside to increase awareness of common 

13   genetic variations that affect the lives of 

14   citizens of New York State; and 

15                "WHEREAS, It is the sense of this  

16   Legislative Body to memorialize Governor Andrew 

17   M. Cuomo to proclaim March 21, 2015, Down 

18   Syndrome Awareness Day in the State of New York, 

19   in conjunction with the observance of World Down 

20   Syndrome Day; and 

21                "WHEREAS, Down syndrome is a genetic 

22   condition affecting the body's development caused 

23   by the presence of three copies of chromosome 21  

24   in the cell nucleus, and is also called Trisomy 

25   21; there are an estimated 7 million people with 


                                                                1049

 1   Down syndrome worldwide; and 

 2                "WHEREAS, One in every 691 babies 

 3   born in the United States are diagnosed with 

 4   Down syndrome, making it the most common genetic 

 5   disorder in the nation; approximately 400,000 

 6   Americans have Down syndrome, and about 6,000 

 7   babies are born with Down syndrome in the United 

 8   States each year; and 

 9                "WHEREAS, While once extremely 

10   fatal, advances in medical technology are helping 

11   individuals with Down syndrome to live longer, 

12   healthier lives than ever before; with proper 

13   treatment, most particularly corrective heart 

14   surgeries, as many as 80 percent of adults with 

15   Down syndrome will reach age 60 or older; and 

16                "WHEREAS, Down Syndrome 

17   International will be celebrating the 10th 

18   Anniversary of World Down Syndrome Day on 

19   March 21, 2015; the date was chosen to represent 

20   the scientific basis  of  the  condition, Trisomy 

21   21; and 

22                "WHEREAS, World Down Syndrome Day is 

23   a global awareness day which has been officially 

24   observed by the United Nations since 2012; each 

25   year the voice of people with Down syndrome, and 


                                                                1050

 1   those who live and work with them, grows louder, 

 2   but there is still so much more to be done; and 

 3                "WHEREAS, More and more New Yorkers 

 4   are interacting with individuals with Down 

 5   syndrome, increasing the need for widespread 

 6   public education and acceptance; and 

 7                "WHEREAS, People with Down syndrome 

 8   in the State of New York possess a wide range of 

 9   abilities, and are active participants in 

10   educational, occupational, social, and 

11   recreational circles of the community; and 

12                "WHEREAS, It is the custom of this 

13   Legislative Body to recognize the inherent 

14   dignity, worth and valuable contributions of 

15   persons with Down syndrome as promoters of the 

16   well-being and diversity of our communities, and 

17   the importance of their individual autonomy and 

18   independence, including the freedom to make their 

19   own choices; now, therefore, be it 

20                "RESOLVED, That this Legislative 

21   Body pause in its deliberations to memorialize 

22   Governor Andrew M. Cuomo to proclaim March 21, 

23   2015, as Down Syndrome Awareness Day in the State 

24   of New York, in conjunction with the observance 

25   of World Down Syndrome Day; and be it further 


                                                                1051

 1                "RESOLVED, That a copy of this  

 2   resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted to  

 3   the Honorable Andrew M. Cuomo, Governor of the 

 4   State of New York."
